person.description: Ivan Le Kang Ho is a computer science and mathematics student at Stanford University, and a composer and performer, from Auckland, New Zealand. He has worked as a software and data engineer at the Cancer Society of New Zealand, researched authorship inequality in international scientific collaboration, built speech preprocessing pipelines at a speech and cognitive development lab, and taught Python to students in Chin State, Myanmar. He writes choral and chamber music and performs as a singer, saxophonist and violinist.
award: Dux and Valedictorian, King’s College, Auckland, 2024
